page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; a narrow empty column to the right with no printed text; no margin notes. Above the column: running head "LIB. I. Scutum Regium." and page number 29 at the right.

main_text.p: fica David fopiiffet, Goliah Ifraelitarum terrorem (lapide è funda emiffo) truci-daffet, & denique ducenta Philifteo-rum Sauli, pro filia ejus Michol præsen-taffet præputia. Neque his tamen in David generum fuum, & jam unctum in regem contentus injuriis, conjugem ejus alteri tradidit, ipsum ac parentes fuos patria expulit, ejus caufa Sacerdo-tes octoginta quinque, præter Sacer-dotem fummum, interfecit, Nobe eo-rum civitatem, unà cum viris & mulie-ribus, parvulis & lactantibus,ovibus & alinis gladio percuffit, & denique mag-no exercitu à loco ad locum, ejus ani-mam tanquam pulicem aut perdicem perfequebatur. Hercle, fi ufquam, fi ufpiam; justa cuiquam dari poffit ratio regem iniuftum è medio auferendi, Da-vidi ista datur. Quid interim ille? quas eructat minas? quam vindictam medi-tatur ? de tolerando quidem cogitat magis quàm de tollendo, de ferendo quàm de feriendo: imò,à feriendo tan-tum abhorruit, ut cùm femel in spe-lunca, & iterum in tentorio ei daretur oportunitas (qua oportunior dari non potuit)

page.notes: The right-hand column is empty. Possible printing or reading doubts: "fopiiffet" (likely "fopiffet"/"fopiiffet" as printed), "ufquam", "iniuftum" and "ufpiam" are transcribed as printed. The first line begins with a fragment "fica" that continues from the previous page and is kept as a fragment. Last line "potuit)" is printed with a closing parenthesis. The catchword and signature are not visible.
